invariants.rationale: The method always returns a TiledMap instance as constructed by 'loadTiledMap', which does not return null.
The resolved file is created from fileName; a null fileName would likely cause an exception prior to method exit.
The method dereferences fields of parameter multiple times, so it cannot be null at method exit.
Because 'result' is directly the return value from 'loadTiledMap', which returns a TiledMap.
The method sets owned resources on 'result' before returning, so this getter should not return null.
